evidence: Static read-only public asset inspection, conditional on fixed input imageData and ordinary character branch; no runtime parity claim
findings: The common path holds ramp K from a mode pool or charSet, and input pixels ep from imageData.
It estimates luminance minimum/maximum on a sampled grid using .299R+.587G+.114B; zero normalization span becomes1.
Cell pixels are selected at floored cell centers mapped into input imageData dimensions, rather than the current core area average.

For fixed imageData, normalized luminance M is computed before the contrast/brightness RGB channel stage. The later ordinary ramp index derives from M plus threshold/edge terms, not those tone-adjusted channels.
The nonrandom ordinary selection indexes the provided ramp directly with a clamped brightness-derived index; no browser coverage-sorted dictionary selection is visible in this bounded path.
limits: Upstream imageData preparation and every optional branch are not proved here.
Threshold, edge, animation, alpha, grading and style-specific branches require separate full semantics/fixtures.
The isolated affine contrast mapping does not establish full Rust/reference character output equivalence; current core has intentionally different sampling/matching.
